**Potential1200 1.0.1**

- **Every break becomes a 2-bar loop that starts on a kick on the 1**, so it spreads evenly across the 8 pads whatever the file's length. A loop file starts on its own bar line; a long drum take or song gets a random 2 bars that start on a kick on a strong beat (a different part each RANDOM BREAK). A 1-bar loop stays 1 bar.
- **Loop tempo from the file's length.** A loop without the tempo in its name gets the tempo that fits its length in whole bars, so MATCH (TUNE) and MATCH (STRETCH) play it at the right speed.
- **PERFORM:** the TUNE / DECAY / LEVEL / FILTER keys no longer touch the display.
